disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 运行时插件不直接读取凭据文件：所有 Provider API Key 通过 Harness 凭据接缝 credentials.resolve() 解析（lib/index.js、lib/accounts.js、lib/subscriptions.js）。subscriptions.js 读取 ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json 是 OpenCode Go 适配器的文档化本地回退，只把用户自己的 Key 发给 OpenCode 官方额度接口，属良性机制。
checked_items.en: The runtime plugin does not directly read credential files: all Provider API Keys are resolved via the Harness credential seam credentials.resolve() (lib/index.js, lib/accounts.js, lib/subscriptions.js). subscriptions.js reads ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json as the documented local fallback of the OpenCode Go adapter, which only sends the user's own key to the OpenCode official quota endpoint, which is a benign mechanism.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中裁决（DSH-C01 映射规则 DG-R1-51，共 10 处）：9 处为文档或界面文案中提及 .credentials.yaml 路径的文本（README.md、docs/research/ccswitch-provider-usage.md、lib/client.js 提示文案、scripts/install.mjs 提示），1 处为开发脚本 scripts/check-balance.mjs（读取用户自己的凭据查询 DeepSeek 余额，只发往 api.deepseek.com，且该脚本不在 npm 包 files 清单内、不随包发布）。全部确认良性，不构成凭据窃取。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan hit adjudication (DSH-C01 maps to rule DG-R1-51, 10 hits in total): 9 are text mentioning the .credentials.yaml path in documentation or UI copy (README.md, docs/research/ccswitch-provider-usage.md, lib/client.js prompt text, scripts/install.mjs prompt), 1 is a development script scripts/check-balance.mjs (reads the user's own credentials to query DeepSeek balance, only sends to api.deepseek.com, and this script is not in the npm package files list and is not shipped with the package). All confirmed benign, no credential theft.

evidence.zh: 检查了凭据读取与外联组合面：运行时无凭据文件读取，凭据仅经 Harness 接缝解析后用于向 Provider 所属 HTTPS 接口查询余额/额度；DNS 解析结果经私网地址过滤，连接固定到已校验地址，无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Checked the credential reading and outbound connection combination: no credential file reading at runtime; credentials are only resolved via the Harness seam and used to query balance/quota from Provider-owned HTTPS endpoints; DNS resolution results are filtered by private network addresses, connections are pinned to verified addresses, no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部源码、README、docs、SECURITY.md 等文本面：无指令覆写措辞、无伪装系统消息、无远程指令加载、无审批绕过措辞。插件不注册 LLM 工具、不注入系统提示，README 中关于凭据存放的说明为正常配置引导。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all source code, README, docs, SECURITY.md and other text surfaces: no instruction override wording, no disguised system message, no remote instruction loading, no approval bypass wording. The plugin does not register LLM tools, does not inject system prompts; the README instructions about credential storage are normal configuration guidance.

checked_items.zh: 未发现 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、.claude、.cursor、MCP 配置等模型面指令文件；客户端 bundle 仅注入 sidebar.footer.action 插槽，不触碰系统提示。
checked_items.en: No model-surface instruction files found such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, .claude, .cursor, MCP configuration; the client bundle only injects the sidebar.footer.action slot, does not touch system prompts.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册 LLM 工具（无工具注册调用），只在 Web 服务器上挂五个 /api/usage-stats/* 只读 GET 路由，不存在可投毒的工具描述。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register LLM tools (no tool registration calls), only mounts five read-only GET routes /api/usage-stats/* on the Web server; there are no tool descriptions that could be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述承载诱导安装或改写配置的措辞；安装器 install.mjs 是用户主动运行的本地安装程序，与提示注入无关。
evidence.en: No tool description contains wording that induces installation or modifies configuration; the installer install.mjs is a local installation script actively run by the user, unrelated to prompt injection.

checked_items.zh: 递归扫描全部 yml：cordis.patch.yml 仅含简单 -insert 语句，无 !!js 可执行标量。package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子。源码无 eval 等危险求值；唯一的 new Function 与 child_process 出现在测试脚本中，均不随包发布。
checked_items.en: Recursively scanned all yml: cordis.patch.yml only contains simple -insert statements, no !!js executable scalars. package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks. Source code has no dangerous evaluation like eval; the only new Function and child_process appear in test scripts, which are not shipped with the package.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle（lib/client.js）专项扫描：React 面板 UI，只做同域 fetch；keydown 监听器仅响应 Escape 键关闭面板，无键盘记录、无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC。
checked_items.en: Special scan of client bundle (lib/client.js): React panel UI, only performs same-origin fetch; the keydown listener only responds to Escape key to close the panel, no keylogging, no clipboard access, no credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中裁决：DSH-X07 映射 DG-R3-59（.github/workflows/ci.yml、.github/workflows/pages.yml）为标准 CI 测试与 GitHub Pages 部署工作流，良性工程配置；DSH-X05 映射 DG-R3-57（lib/client.js:604 keydown 监听器）仅 Escape 处理；DSH-X03 映射 DG-R3-55（scripts/smoke-client.mjs:42 new Function、scripts/test-install.mjs:5 spawnSync）均为测试脚本，不随包发布。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan hit adjudication: DSH-X07 maps to DG-R3-59 (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/pages.yml) are standard CI testing and GitHub Pages deployment workflows, benign engineering configuration; DSH-X05 maps to DG-R3-57 (lib/client.js:604 keydown listener) only processes Escape; DSH-X03 maps to DG-R3-55 (scripts/smoke-client.mjs:42 new Function, scripts/test-install.mjs:5 spawnSync) are all test scripts, not shipped with the package.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 无 !!js 标量，仅定义插件插入；包内全部 yml 均无 loader 可执行标签，patch 即 RCE 面不适用。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml has no !!js scalars, only defines plugin insertion; all yml files in the package have no loader executable tags, thus the patch RCE surface is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 源码中无 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用，无自修改代码执行工具。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run calls in source code, no self-modifying code execution tools.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；.github/workflows 为 CI/CD 惯例配置，不含外联、凭据读取或隐蔽下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks; .github/workflows are CI/CD convention configurations, containing no outbound connections, credential reading, or covert download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明 dsh.client（platform:web），对客户端 bundle 完成专项扫描：仅 UI 面板与同域数据接口交互，无危险浏览器能力。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client (platform:web), and a special scan of the client bundle has been completed: only UI panel interacting with same-origin data interface, no dangerous browser capabilities.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部外联路径：服务端仅向已配置 Provider 所属 HTTPS 接口发请求（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Z.ai、Kimi、MiniMax、Ollama、OpenCode Go、New API、Sub2API 等官方余额/额度端点）；连接前做 DNS 地址过滤（阻断私网/环回/保留地址）并固定到已校验地址，强制 HTTPS、手动重定向、1 MiB 响应上限。客户端仅向同域 /api/usage-stats/* 发起 fetch。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound paths: the server only sends requests to configured Provider-owned HTTPS endpoints (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Z.ai, Kimi, MiniMax, Ollama, OpenCode Go, New API, Sub2API, etc. official balance/quota endpoints); performs DNS address filtering before connection (blocks private network/loopback/reserved addresses) and pins to verified addresses, enforces HTTPS, manual redirects, 1 MiB response limit. The client only fetches same-origin /api/usage-stats/*.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发、隧道、粘贴板等带外通道；未发现 AI 端点或代理劫持配置。
checked_items.en: No out-of-band channels found such as encoded exfiltration, tunneling, clipboard; no AI endpoint or proxy hijacking configuration found.

evidence.zh: 凭据经 Harness 接缝解析，不进入日志或第三方请求；外联目标全部为 Provider 自有域名，且受私网地址过滤与 HTTPS 强制约束，无未声明外联。
evidence.en: Credentials are resolved via the Harness seam, not entering logs or third-party requests; all outbound targets are Provider-owned domains, constrained by private network address filtering and HTTPS enforcement, no undeclared outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 核对 manifest 与依赖：作用域包名 @ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats 无撞名仿冒；无浮动 git 依赖（任务卡给定完整 40 位 commit）；无安装钩子；catalog 自发布到作者 GitHub Pages 供市场收录，内容与包版本对齐。
checked_items.en: Verified manifest and dependencies: scoped package name @ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats has no name collision or impersonation; no floating git dependencies (full 40-character commit hashes pinned); no install hooks; catalog self-published to author's GitHub Pages for marketplace listing, content aligned with package version.

checked_items.zh: 检查 patch 安全面：cordis.patch.yml 未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 安全行，无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权写法、未改写 inject/intercept。
checked_items.en: Checked patch security: cordis.patch.yml does not touch sandbox/approval/permission security lines, no disabled:true, no environment variable privilege reduction syntax, does not modify inject/intercept.

evidence.zh: patch 仅 -insert 插件入口，不含禁用安全插件、降权或覆盖安全行的内容。
evidence.en: The patch only -inserts the plugin entry, contains no content that disables security plugins, reduces privileges, or overrides security lines.

evidence.zh: 插件只经 ctx.effect 注册路由与定时刷新，未监听 tools/pre-execute、approval/request 等 waterfall 安全事件，无审批链截断面。
evidence.en: The plugin only registers routes and periodic refresh via ctx.effect, does not listen for waterfall security events like tools/pre-execute, approval/request, no approval chain interception surface.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无基线版本可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First audit, no baseline version for comparison of upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不影响安全插件的必需服务依赖。
evidence.en: The patch does not modify inject/intercept configuration, does not affect the required service dependencies of security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务器上注册五个 /api/usage-stats/* 精确路由，每个入口先做 loopback 围栏校验（对端 socket 地址 + Host 头），拒绝非 GET 方法，非本机请求返回 403；后台每 5 分钟刷新一次 Provider 余额与用量聚合，失败仅记日志不影响宿主。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers five exact routes /api/usage-stats/* on the host Web server, each entry performs a loopback fence check (peer socket address + Host header), rejects non-GET methods, returns 403 for non-local requests; background refreshes Provider balance and usage aggregation every 5 minutes, failure only logs without affecting the host.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（L4 为 na），运行时行为基于静态分析评估。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled (L4 is na), runtime behavior assessed based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 五个路由均有 loopback 围栏与 GET 方法限制，属宿主 Web 服务器固有暴露面内的最小暴露；未发现插件主动监听额外端口或弱化宿主认证面。
evidence.en: All five routes have loopback fence and GET method restriction, which is minimal exposure within the host Web server's inherent attack surface; no additional port listening or weakening of host authentication surface found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份检查通过：dsh.bundle.patch、dsh.client 声明齐全，包名无仿冒，作者信息一致。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: dsh.bundle.patch, dsh.client declarations complete, package name no impersonation, author information consistent.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：15 条机器命中全部经人工裁决为良性（文档文本、测试脚本、标准 CI 配置），无危险 YAML、安装钩子或代码执行 sink 成立。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 15 machine hits adjudicated manually as benign (documentation text, test scripts, standard CI configuration); no dangerous YAML, install hooks, or code execution sink established.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷；凭据经 Harness 接缝解析；外联目标为 Provider 所属 HTTPS 接口且受地址过滤约束。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads; credentials resolved via Harness seam; outbound targets are Provider-owned HTTPS endpoints constrained by address filtering.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：无工具描述注入、无 schema poisoning、能力声明与观测面一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: no tool description injection, no schema poisoning, capability declarations consistent with observed surface.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed in this phase.

limits.zh: L4 动态沙箱未启用。package.json 未声明 dsh 引擎版本，engines.dsh 填 unspecified，兼容矩阵按 untested 处理。scripts/ 下多个测试脚本（smoke-client、test-*、validate-fold、verify-raw）不随 npm 包发布（files 清单未包含），仅作为开发测试面审查。
limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled. package.json does not declare dsh engine version, engines.dsh is set to unspecified, compatibility matrix treated as untested. Multiple test scripts under scripts/ (smoke-client, test-*, validate-fold, verify-raw) are not shipped with the npm package (not included in files list), reviewed only as a development test surface.
